general.dl: BS-MD Early Assurance Honors Track — check current cycle deadline
general.note: The only direct BS-MD physically in California: 3+4 and 4+4 Early Assurance Honors Tracks into CNU College of Medicine, with friendlier entry stats than classic BS/MDs. Eyes-open caveats: young school with a thin undergrad reputation, commuter campus near Sacramento, the med seat is conditional on progression benchmarks (not iron-clad), and total cost runs high.
general.medNote: Estimate-heavy entry by design — verify every number and condition directly before applying.

accel.gate: 3.9 UNWEIGHTED + SAT 1450/ACT 32 + five AP exams scored 4+ (verified Sep 2026)
accel.note: The only accelerated route physically in California. The 6-year option is gone — it is now 3+4 (accelerated) or 4+4. Conditional seat (progression benchmarks), young school, high total price.
accel.why: OUT at 3.67 — the verified bar is 3.9 unweighted + 1450 + five 4+ AP scores. The 4+4 Early Assurance track has softer terms; ask CNU directly if California matters enough.
